## Farnell adds Amphenol Nexus Technologies to strengthen rugged connectivity solutions globally


October 6, 2026


[FAR 1218 Inline](https://news.avnet.com/files/images/farnell/1920_far1218inline.jpg)


*Partnership expands access to rugged connector and switching solutions for demanding communications and control applications*


Farnell has announced a new partnership with Amphenol NEXUS Technologies, expanding access to rugged connector and switching solutions for customers designing and maintaining critical communications and control systems.


Through the partnership, Farnell will offer Amphenol NEXUS Technologies' portfolio of:


· Audio connectors


· Waterproof breakaway connectors


· TAC connectors


· Ranger connectors


· M55116/MIL-SPEC-type connectors


· Microphone and telephone plugs and jacks


· Momentary push-button switches


Designed for demanding environments, the products deliver reliable performance in applications where signal integrity, durability and dependable operation are essential.


The portfolio supports customers across a range of industries, including:


· Military and defense communications


· Commercial aviation electronics


· Telecommunications


· Medical devices


· Simulation controls


· Motorsport


· Marine applications


· Agricultural equipment


By adding Amphenol NEXUS Technologies, Farnell provides engineers, OEMs and procurement professionals with greater access to proven connectivity solutions designed for critical communications and control systems.


"This partnership gives our customers access to a broader range of trusted connectivity solutions for demanding communications and control applications,” **said Tony Coletto, Vice President, Supplier Management, Farnell** . "Amphenol NEXUS Technologies' expertise in rugged audio connectors, switches and interconnect technologies helps engineers and procurement teams source reliable products that perform in harsh and mission-critical environments.


Founded in 1961 and part of Amphenol Corporation since 2008, Amphenol NEXUS Technologies has built a reputation for manufacturing rugged, high-quality connector and switch solutions. Its products are widely used in military and commercial communications markets and support applications requiring reliable connectivity and mechanical performance.


"We are excited to work with Farnell to make our products available to a broader global customer base," **said Greg Diblasi, General Manager, Amphenol NEXUS Technologies** . "Farnell's strong engineering audience, technical expertise and global reach make them an ideal partner. Together, we look forward to helping customers access the reliable, high-performance technologies they need for critical communications and control applications."


Amphenol NEXUS Technologies products are available now from


[Farnell](https://uk.farnell.com/b/amphenol-nexus) in EMEA,


[Newark](https://www.newark.com/b/amphenol-nexus) in North America, and


[element14](https://sg.element14.com/b/amphenol-nexus) in APAC.
